prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single, universally “best” lawyer — the right one depends on the specifics of your truck crash, your priorities (trial experience vs. settlement, budget, communication style), and the lawyer’s experience with commercial truck cases and FMCSA/regulatory issues. I can help you find highly qualified Dallas attorneys, but first here’s how to choose one and immediate next steps you should take.

What to look for in a truck‑accident lawyer
- Substantial truck/tractor‑trailer experience (not just car crashes). Trucking cases involve different federal/state rules, black‑box data, logbooks, carrier/subcontractor liability, and independent investigations.  
- Trial experience and record of significant truck accident verdicts/settlements. Many insurers won’t offer fair settlements unless the attorney can and will take the case to trial.  
- Resources: in‑house investigators, accident reconstructionists, medical experts, and the ability to pursue large trucking companies.  
- Credentials: board certification in personal injury/civil trial law (if available), peer ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell AV, Super Lawyers), and client reviews.  
- Communication and who will actually handle the case (partner vs. junior associate).  
- Contingency fee arrangement and clear explanation of costs and refunds for expenses if you don’t win.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many truck/18‑wheeler cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases against the carrier involved? Any verdicts/settlements you can summarize?  
- Who will be my primary contact? Will my case use outside experts?  
- What is your contingency fee and who pays expenses?  
- How long will this probably take and what are realistic outcomes?  
- Any disciplinary history with the Texas Bar?

How to find and vet attorneys
- Use local searches and directories: Texas State Bar attorney lookup, SuperLawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, and The National Trial Lawyers.  
- Check Texas Bar disciplinary records.  
- Compare 3–5 attorneys/firms in Dallas, take consultations, and pick the one you trust.

Immediate steps after a truck accident
- Get medical care and keep records.  
- Preserve evidence (photos of scene, vehicle damage, skid marks, signage).  
- Get police report and witness contact info.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to the insurer without attorney advice.  
- Note the truck number, carrier name, driver name, and any photos of logbooks/placards if safe.

If you want, I can:
- Look up and suggest 3–5 highly rated Dallas truck‑accident attorneys (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood or permission to search), or  
- Draft a short email or list of questions you can use in consultations, or  
- Help you evaluate a shortlist if you already have a few names.

Which would you prefer?
